summary: Phase 6A — Property Identity Core: 35/35 backend tests PASS. All areas verified: onboarding idempotency (client_submission_id resume + auth guard), GPS accuracy tiers (7m/20m/40m/75m/MAP_SELECTED with correct verification status + message), PATCH details/listing + GET draft, submit creates properties_geo + property_listings + audit rows + counter (verified directly in Mongo), idempotent submit returning idempotent:true with same IDs, mismatched CSID → 404, all three validation guards (missing location/details/listing → 400), public /api/properties-v2/{amass_id} strips created_by, alias resolution returns resolved_via_alias + requested_id, listings public endpoint returns array, state code mapping (FCT, Rivers→RIV, unknown fallback to 3-char uppercase), sequential counter increments +1 on adjacent submits and stays distinct under concurrent (ThreadPoolExecutor) submits, 2dsphere $near query returns Lagos rows, /mine has no cross-agent leak (fresh user sees only own row), and full regression sweep (auth/me, /properties, agent plans, subscription, public agent slug, /share/property, /agent/score, /crm/leads, old POST /api/properties quota) — all 200 or business codes, no 5xx. No code was modified.
critical_code_review_comments: property_identity.py:239 PATCH /{oid} — no explicit 400 if both details and listing are omitted; currently silently returns {ok:true}. Low priority but consider guarding.

property_identity.py:273 submit — validation order returns 'Location required' before 'Property details required'; the test suite adapted, but consider making the order deterministic across missing combinations (order is checked as location→details→listing which is fine).

property_identity.py:403 /mine — uses agent_id from listings; if a listing exists without a matching properties_geo doc, `property` will be None. Acceptable for now but consider filtering out orphans.
property_identity.py:377 public GET — strips only created_by; consider also stripping media_ids or internal audit refs if any are added later.
seed_data_creation: Created ~10 properties_geo rows (Lagos, FCT, Rivers, one unknown-state) plus ~5 orphan onboarding drafts and one fresh throwaway user during test session. All test data is prefixed with 'TEST_'/'pi6a_' or transient CSIDs; safe to leave in dev DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_property_identity_phase6a.py is reusable. It uses EXPO_BACKEND_URL then falls back to EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Runs in ~6s via pytest-xdist (2 workers). Mongo direct-check helpers use MONGO_URL + DB_NAME.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all tests pass; no bug to root-cause.
